description: This file provides a JavaScript API client for interacting with the Jamendo music API. It includes functions for searching tracks, fetching featured tracks, and internal utilities for URL building, data normalization, and fetch handling. The code is designed for frontend usage, leveraging environment variables for API credentials and exposing functions for external modules.

methods.name: getJamendoClientId()
methods.description: Retrieves the Jamendo client ID from environment variables, returning an empty string if not set.

methods.name: buildUrl(path, params)
methods.description: Constructs a URL with appended query parameters, handling both relative and absolute paths.

methods.name: normalizeTrack(t)
methods.description: Normalizes a Jamendo track object into a frontend-friendly format with HTTPS URLs and key fields.

methods.name: safeFetchJson(url)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with error handling, returning a standardized response object.

methods.name: searchTracks({ query, page = 1, pageSize = 30 } = {})
methods.description: Performs a search for tracks on Jamendo based on a query string, with pagination options, returning normalized track items.

methods.name: getFeaturedTracks({ page = 1, pageSize = 30 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches popular tracks from Jamendo, suitable for a homepage or feature section.

ctags.name: searchTracks
ctags.pattern: /^export async function searchTracks({ query, page = 1, pageSize = 30 } = {}) {$/
